# Expected changes for the Burning Springs update on December 2nd, 2025 (Patch 64)

![Expected changes for the Burning Springs update on December 2nd, 2025 (Patch 64)](/uploads/584_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

On December 2nd, 2025** the next and, according to Bethesda, largest content update since Wastelanders for Fallout 76 will be released. There is a **new map expansion to Ohio** on the west side of the map with many new locations and enemies, a **new quest**, **new legendary mods**, **new events**, a **new bounty hunter system** and much more. Here you can now read a summary of all known changes that have already been tested on the PTS and were found via data mining and that we can expect in the **Burning Springs Update**.

There are many parallels to **2 in the Burning Springs Update. Season** of the **Fallout series on Amazon Prime Video**, from the desert landscape to the **Ghoul** who personally gives you bounty orders, to the **Ghoul Revolver** "Dom Pedro" and various casino-related items for the Atom Shop.

### Index

## Map expansion to Burning Springs / Ohio

After the map expansion to the south with Skyline Valley, the next expansion of the map awaits you west to Burning Springs in Ohio. According to Bethesda, this update is the largest expansion to Fallout 76 in terms of space.

However, the new area is only accessible via the Silver Bridge in Point Pleasant. You cannot enter the western bank towards Burning Springs and from Burning Springs you cannot go over the mountains to the Ohio River. There are probably technical reasons for this, but it would be good if the map in this area could be explored more freely in the future.

On this map you can see the new region with the accessible areas marked in color:

### The 25 new locations in Burning Springs are (from north to south):

| | | 

The new map expansion Burning Springs brings a completely new Fallout 76 feeling, the desert, vegetation, buildings and the weather with its sandstorms and the fantastic night sky almost seem as if you were in Fallout: New Vegas or Fallout 3. The fallout feeling comes across really well.

Of course, you can also set up your own CAMP in all places except for the infamous “No Camp Zones” and e.g. build a desert raider camp. Or maybe a bounty hunter hideout.

## New quest line

If you are new and have just come from the Vault, or are creating a new character, "The Ghoul" greets you as you leave the Vault and tells you about Highway Town, where you can help him with his bounty hunts.

### Burning Springs Main Quest

The Burning Springs main quest takes you directly after entering Checkpoint Canyon with a jump into The Rust Kingdom to the Rust King. This is in the very south of Burning Springs. From there, the quest takes you to numerous locations in the new area and you can explore everything.

In the main quest you will also be introduced directly to the basics of bounty hunting. Killing and preparing new enemies on site is also part of the quest.

### Sidequest: Dirty Laundry

Everywhere in Burning Springs you can find **Abraxodyne information**, these are suitcases with an Abraxodyne print. As soon as you collect one of them or enter the city of Athens, the quest starts automatically.

There are **150 Abraxodyne Information** suitcases. You can only collect each suitcase once per character. You can find the number of suitcases collected in your challenges. 

After **76** you will receive the **Meadow Breath Sprayer** (Plasma Flamer): 

1*Anti Armor

2* inertia

3* durability

After **150** you will receive the **Prototype ABX03** (Plasma Flamethrower):

1* *-* 3*** like meadow breath sprayer

4* The Pyromancer

The weapons cannot be modded, but they are tradable.
